topic: How do GEO vs LEO satellite orbits affect latency and coverage in hybrid networks for rural substation monitoring?
consensus_response: GEO orbits offer broad coverage with high latency, while LEO orbits provide lower latency but require dense constellations. Hybrid networks combining both optimize real-time monitoring in rural areas by balancing latency and coverage. Beamforming, phase array antennas, and inter-satellite links further enhance performance.
reference_context: SatCom systems integrate terrestrial networks with GEO/LEO satellites for global coverage, managing latency and interference.
